analysis.executiveSummary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. is proposing to trade Saquon Barkley and a 2028 1st-round pick (Mile High) to All Hail King Jesus for D'Andre Swift. While Swift offers a higher 2026 C-AVI (81.3 vs 51.4) and a slight boost to weekly PPR scoring during the stretch run, attaching a premium 2028 1st-round pick to Saquon Barkley represents a substantial overpay that unnecessarily drains Corgi Loaf's long-term dynasty value and future liquidity.
